title: XRust: Detecting Logical Races in Rust Linux Drivers
abstract: arXiv:2610.27325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rust is increasingly used in Linux to improve memory safety, but its guarantees do not prevent logical races: individually synchronized operations can still interleave in ways that violate higher-level invariants. Detecting such bugs typically requires manually written specifications and carefully controlled execution environments.   We present XRust, a technique for detecting logical races in Linux Rust drivers without manually specified invariants. Using Logical Happens-Before (LHB) analysis, XRust identifies shared-state accesses relevant to logical ordering, automatically constructs operation-pair harnesses, and uses serial differential oracles to detect concurrent executions inconsistent with either serial order. XRust also uses lightweight userspace abstractions to execute driver code under reproducible schedules. translated_title: XRust：检测Rust Linux驱动程序中的逻辑竞争
translated_abstract: Rust在Linux中的应用日益增多，以提升内存安全性，但其保证并不能防止逻辑竞争：即使各个操作已单独同步，它们仍可能以违反高层不变量的方式交错执行。检测这类缺陷通常需要人工编写的规范说明以及精心控制的执行环境。我们提出XRust，一种无需人工指定不变量即可检测Linux Rust驱动程序中逻辑竞争的技术。借助逻辑先于关系分析，XRust识别与逻辑顺序相关的共享状态访问，自动构造操作对测试基座，并使用串行差分预言机来检测与任一串行顺序不一致的并发执行。XRust还利用轻量级的用户态抽象，在可复现的调度下执行驱动程序代码。应用于Linux 7.3-rc2时，XRust在来自十个驱动程序的102个Rust文件中识别出17个共享对象，构造了1,654个……
tldr: XRust无需人工指定不变量，通过逻辑先于关系分析自动构造操作对测试基座并使用串行差分预言机，实现Linux Rust驱动程序中逻辑竞争的自动检测。
